title: Understanding the Problem
text: You need to select the histogram that best visualizes the distribution of the sample standard deviation from the given options.

title: Characteristics of the Sampling Distribution
text: The sampling distribution of the sample standard deviation is typically bell-shaped and symmetric, especially with a larger sample size.

title: Analyzing the Options
text: Look for a histogram that is symmetric and bell-shaped, which is characteristic of a normal distribution.

title: Selecting the Correct Histogram
text: Which histogram is symmetric and bell-shaped?
